idea-plugin.name: Import Cost Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Run "Check Import Sizes" on a JS/TS file and get a real report of every node_modules package it imports, sorted by on-disk size, with unusually large ones flagged.

Born from real evidence in JetBrains Marketplace reviews of the closest existing plugin in this space (135K downloads, 75% of reviews at 3 stars or fewer): a documented, years-long pattern of severe CPU spikes and IDE freezes -- "drains 100% CPU... battery lasts one hour", "freezes my IDE and I cannot work" -- from recalculating package sizes continuously, inline, on every keystroke.

This plugin's whole design exists to not do that: it runs only when you ask it to, reads real on-disk package sizes (never invokes a bundler), and never recomputes anything automatically in the background. The direct fix for a performance complaint is a design that structurally can't reproduce it, not a faster version of the same always-on computation.

100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry.

action.description: Reports the on-disk size of every node_modules package this file imports, sorted largest first
